why:
The briefs cover all four must_catch items.
1. Verifier Check 3(d) runs `node BIN a.jsonl missing.jsonl bad.jsonl`. It requires exit 2, a non-empty stderr and stdout "still containing `bad.jsonl:2: ...`", so the missing file and the bad row are tested in one run.
2. Check 4 runs `git diff <merge-base with main>..HEAD -- packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js`, comparing the head with the base, and fails if lint(text) "differs in any way".
3. Builder step 4 says "Update packages/jsonl-lint/README.md" with the multi-file usage, `-` and the exit codes.
4. Check 6 runs `gh pr view --json body,headRefOid,state` and `gh pr checks`. It requires the body to contain the Closes line and "the `test` workflow check passes at the head SHA".
